name: PUBH 5405
title: Social and Behavioral Foundations of Public Health
description: Introductory survey emphasizing basic social science concepts in the analysis of public health including orientations toward health, disease and health care, the origins and distribution of health care resources, and the role of social movements and research in improving public health.
requirement_description: Open only to Master of Public Health (MPH) and Foundations of Public Health Certificate students; others with department consent.
